name: gizmoduck
description: Gizmoduck — run Nuclei scans on their own, or the whole scanner routine (checkov, trivy, dependency-check, semgrep, ZAP, testssl, nmap, nikto, gated sqlmap) from one manifest; diff against previous scans; triaged Markdown/HTML/PDF reports with a coverage table; ServiceDesk Plus tickets after one batch confirmation. Runs on WSL/Linux and Windows.
